'''2005 Michigan Mini-Open''' was a Star Wars CCG constructed tournament in Michigan (12 March 2005). It is known from the decklists below, recovered from DeckTech posts and Players Committee forms.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Michigan
* '''Dates:''' 12 March 2005
